topic: The Valley of the End clone trick: Madara could tell wood clones apart, so why did Hashirama's clone still fool him; a side point from the long, not its answer
title: Madara Could Spot a Clone. So How Was He Fooled?
description: Madara Uchiha could tell a wood clone from the real thing, according to the chapters, so how did Hashirama fool him at the Valley of the End? Here is the tactical detail most fans forget. Full story on the channel.
comment: Was the clone trick luck, or did Hashirama plan for Madara to run out of chakra?

lines.text: Madara could spot a wood clone. So how did Hashirama fool him?

lines.text: Chapter 577 says only Madara could tell a clone from the original.

shot.fallback: anime style, glowing red Sharingan eye close-up, focused stare

lines.text: Hashirama's wood clones were nearly indistinguishable from himself.

lines.text: His flowering trees could knock opponents out with pollen, per chapter 621.

lines.text: And Madara's Wood Release matched his own, per chapter 609.

lines.text: Then the Valley of the End fight dragged on until both men were exhausted, per chapter 399.

lines.text: Here's my read: that exhaustion is the crack the clone trick needed.

lines.text: Madara's sharp eyes meant nothing once his body gave out.
